title: Existence of a regular meromorphic section
statement: Let X be a proper locally Noetherian scheme [def-weil-proper-morphism] over a field k with finite dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] and no embedded points, and let L be an invertible O_X-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Then there exists a meromorphic section s of L such that the canonical map K_X \to K_X(L) is injective (that is, s is a regular meromorphic section in the sense of Stacks Project, Divisors, Tag 02OZ).

source.place: Tag 02OZ (Lemma 31.5.10, label divisors-lemma-regular-meromorphic-section-exists), case (3), for a scheme without embedded points

proof.text: Let X^0 be the set of generic points of the irreducible components of X. For eta in X^0 the stalk L_eta is free of rank one over O_{X,eta}, since L is locally isomorphic to O_X [def-sc-invertible-module]; choose a generator s_eta. By [lem-sc-meromorphic-sheaf-generic-product] with U=X, sending a global meromorphic section of L to its germs at the points of X^0 is a bijection K_X(L)(X) \to prod_{eta in X^0} L_eta; let s be the meromorphic section of L corresponding to (s_eta)_eta.

source.place: Tag 0EMI, proof: pick a generator s_eta of the free rank 1 module L_eta at each generic point, using the description of K_X and K_X(L) in Tag 0EMH

proof.text: Let U be open in X. By [lem-sc-meromorphic-sheaf-generic-product] for U and its compatibility with multiplication, the map K_X(U) \to K_X(L)(U), f \mapsto fs, becomes prod_{eta in X^0 cap U} O_{X,eta} \to prod_{eta in X^0 cap U} L_eta, (a_eta) \mapsto (a_eta s_eta). Multiplication by a generator of a free rank-one module is injective, and a product of injective maps is injective. So K_X \to K_X(L) is injective on every open, and s is a regular meromorphic section.

source.place: Tag 0EMI, proof: s = prod s_eta is a regular meromorphic section
